title: Design: Edit Part Request for an inventory part
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test at your location, in category A, cost $10.00.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, made after customer B's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1), with that inventory part on line 1.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • A dialog titled "Edit Part Request" opens with Part Number, Description *, Quantity, Source, Category, Vendor, Cost, Core Charge, Sell Price and Margin, as in picture 11.1.
  • Cost is gray (not editable); Source shows Inventory; Category shows category A.
  • Under Cost it reads "The cost of an inventory part can't be re-entered." in small gray text.
  • A red Remove Part button sits at the bottom left, Cancel and a blue Save Part at the bottom right.
